resources.string: Let Android choose (follows headphones and Bluetooth)
Remembered: Baaja switches back to it whenever it reconnects

Normalization, EQ and sound shaping run in 32-bit float and the result goes to Android as float, so boosts don\'t clip. Silence skipping and speed still run at 16-bit before that. Uses a little more battery. Changing it restarts the current song from where it was.

DJ-style transitions: skips silence at the end and start of songs, starts the blend where a song fades out and evens out the volume of both songs. Songs that end abruptly use your crossfade length (up to 4 s). If a song isn\'t analysed in time, the normal crossfade is used.
Used for abrupt endings and as the fallback
Keeps your %1$d most-played songs (last 90 days) downloaded. Songs you downloaded yourself are never removed.
Smart downloads wait for an unmetered network and pause if you leave it
